summary: Accepted after independent re-review. The revised EC supplies an exact, uniquely parsed 15-row Cloud Tasks-shaped scope with explicit category exclusions and a fail-closed performance boundary that keeps Cloud Tasks performance unproven and VAT/Relay evidence local only. Defer-side cases independently exercise every in-scope row, including real HTTP method/header/body delivery, retry/idempotency, public cancel/inspect, HMAC negatives, and three-node Raft proofs for globally committed rate/burst/in-flight limits plus DeadLettered convergence and durable restart. The corrected competitor row records Cloud Tasks retry exhaustion as deletion rather than DLQ parity.
